name: autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor
description: Fraction of a table's current row count that, when added to autovacuum_analyze_threshold, determines the number of row changes (inserts/updates/deletes) that trigger an automatic ANALYZE.
symptoms: Stale query plans due to outdated statistics
Poor join order or index selection by planner
Sudden query performance regressions after bulk DML
tuning_tips: Lower this value (e.g., 0.02–0.05) for tables with frequent DML to keep statistics fresher; raise it (e.g., 0.2–0.5) for large, mostly-read-only tables to reduce ANALYZE overhead.
